name: Modal dialog
summary: A centered window that blocks the page behind it until the person responds. Use it for short, decision-focused tasks.

anatomy.purpose: Dims the page and signals the page is inactive. Click or tap on it closes the dialog unless the action is destructive or has unsaved input.
The dialog surface. Holds all other parts and carries role=dialog.
One line that names the decision or task. Labels the dialog for assistive tech (aria-labelledby).
Short explanation or a small form. Scrolls inside the container if it overflows.
Icon button in the top corner. Always present, even when footer actions exist.
One primary action and at most one secondary action. Primary sits on the trailing edge.

variants.name: Confirmation
variants.use: Ask the person to confirm one action, especially a destructive one.

variants.name: Form
variants.use: Collect a few fields without leaving the page.

contentLimits.title: max 60 characters
contentLimits.body: up to 5 fields; more than that should be a page

variants.name: Information
variants.use: Show a short notice the person must read before continuing.

whenToUse: The person must decide or confirm before continuing.
The task is short, self-contained and needs the page context hidden.
A destructive or irreversible action needs a second check.
whenNotToUse: The content is long or multi-step: use a full page or a stepper instead.
The message is a passive notice: use a toast or inline alert instead.
The content is a quick tip tied to one element: use a tooltip or popover.
On mobile, for long forms or menus: use a bottom sheet instead.

accessibility.role: dialog (alertdialog when it asks for confirmation of a destructive action)
keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle focus inside the dialog only (focus trap).
Escape closes the dialog unless unsaved input would be lost.
accessibility.focus: Move focus into the dialog on open (the first field, or the least destructive button). Return focus to the element that opened it on close.
notes: Label with aria-labelledby pointing at the title; describe with aria-describedby pointing at the body.
Make the page behind inert (the native <dialog> element opened with showModal() does this).
Do not rely on the scrim click as the only way to close.
Text and icon contrast must meet WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and UI borders.
